name: 40165 · Shepherdsvlle, KY
findings: ZIP 40165 (Shepherdsvlle) has 78 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (26%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 40165 (Shepherdsvlle) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
